components.css: @font-face { font-family: "Chinese YaHei"; src: local("Microsoft YaHei"), local("微软雅黑"), local("Microsoft YaHei UI"); font-display: swap; unicode-range: U+2E80-9FFF, U+F900-FAFF, U+FE10-FE1F, U+FE30-FE4F, U+FF00-FFEF, U+20000-2FA1F; } .ds-text-link { display: inline-block; padding: 0; font-family: var(--font-text, "Chinese YaHei", -apple-system, ".SFNSText-Regular", "San Francisco", "Roboto", "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", "Lucida Grande", Arial, sans-serif); font-size: calc(17px + var(--font-size-adjust, 0px)); line-height: 1.8; color: var(--accent, #24628a); font-weight: 500; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-underline-offset: 0.18em; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-text-link:hover { color: var(--accent-strong, #164665); } .ds-text-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #24628a); outline-offset: 4px; } @media (max-width: 480px) { .ds-text-link { font-size: var(--body-size, calc(1rem + var(--font-size-adjust, 0px))); } }

components.css: :lang(zh-CN) { --font-size-adjust: 1px; --font-text: Helvetica, Tahoma, Arial, STXihei, sans-serif; } @font-face { font-family: "Chinese YaHei"; src: local("Microsoft YaHei"), local("微软雅黑"), local("Microsoft YaHei UI"); font-display: swap; unicode-range: U+2E80-9FFF, U+F900-FAFF, U+FE10-FE1F, U+FE30-FE4F, U+FF00-FFEF, U+20000-2FA1F; } .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-start; max-width: var(--max, 980px); margin: 0 auto; padding: 1rem 1.5rem; gap: 1rem 2rem; font-family: var(--font-text, "Chinese YaHei", -apple-system, ".SFNSText-Regular", "San Francisco", "Roboto", "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", "Lucida Grande", Arial, sans-serif); font-size: calc(17px + var(--font-size-adjust, 0px)); line-height: 1.8; } .ds-nav-links { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.3rem 1.15rem; } .ds-nav-links a { padding: 0.25rem 0; color: var(--muted, #62686d); font-size: var(--body-size, calc(1.06rem + var(--font-size-adjust, 0px))); font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-underline-offset: 0.18em; } .ds-nav-links a:hover { color: var(--accent, #24628a); text-decoration: underline; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #24628a); outline-offset: 4px; } @media (max-width: 720px) { .ds-nav { align-items: flex-start; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.45rem; padding: 0.8rem 1rem; } .ds-nav-links { gap: 0.25rem 1.1rem; } } @media (max-width: 480px) { .ds-nav { font-size: var(--body-size, calc(1rem + var(--font-size-adjust, 0px))); } } @media (max-width: 980px) { .ds-nav { --body-size: calc(1rem + var(--font-size-adjust, 0px)); } } .ds-nav:lang(zh-CN) { line-height: 1.9; }

components.css: @font-face { font-family: "Chinese YaHei"; src: local("Microsoft YaHei"), local("微软雅黑"), local("Microsoft YaHei UI"); font-display: swap; unicode-range: U+2E80-9FFF, U+F900-FAFF, U+FE10-FE1F, U+FE30-FE4F, U+FF00-FFEF, U+20000-2FA1F; } .ds-section-heading { margin-bottom: 1.45rem; } .ds-section-heading h2 { margin: 0; padding-bottom: 0.6rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #dfe2e5); color: var(--ink, #252a2e); font-family: var(--font-text, "Chinese YaHei", -apple-system, ".SFNSText-Regular", "San Francisco", "Roboto", "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", "Lucida Grande", Arial, sans-serif); font-size: calc(2rem + var(--font-size-adjust, 0px)); font-weight: 650; line-height: 1.3; overflow-wrap: break-word; } .ds-section-heading:lang(zh-CN) h2 { font-weight: 700; } @media (max-width: 980px) { .ds-section-heading h2 { font-size: calc(1.82rem + var(--font-size-adjust, 0px)); } } @media (max-width: 720px) { .ds-section-heading h2 { font-size: calc(1.65rem + var(--font-size-adjust, 0px)); } } @media (max-width: 480px) { .ds-section-heading h2 { font-size: calc(1.72rem + var(--font-size-adjust, 0px)); } }

components.css: @font-face { font-family: "Chinese YaHei"; src: local("Microsoft YaHei"), local("微软雅黑"), local("Microsoft YaHei UI"); font-display: swap; unicode-range: U+2E80-9FFF, U+F900-FAFF, U+FE10-FE1F, U+FE30-FE4F, U+FF00-FFEF, U+20000-2FA1F; } .ds-research { display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding: 0.65rem 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--line, #dfe2e5); color: var(--text, #3d4246); font-family: var(--font-text, "Chinese YaHei", -apple-system, ".SFNSText-Regular", "San Francisco", "Roboto", "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", "Lucida Grande", Arial, sans-serif); font-size: calc(17px + var(--font-size-adjust, 0px)); line-height: 1.8; } .ds-research:lang(zh-CN) { line-height: 1.9; } .ds-research h3 { margin: 0; color: var(--ink, #252a2e); font-size: calc(1.1rem + var(--font-size-adjust, 0px)); font-weight: 650; line-height: 1.45; } .ds-research p { margin: 0.35rem 0 0; max-width: 75ch; line-height: 1.45; } .ds-link-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.4rem 1rem; margin-top: auto; padding-top: 0.35rem; } .ds-link-row a { color: var(--accent, #24628a); font-weight: 500; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-underline-offset: 0.18em; } .ds-link-row a:hover { color: var(--accent-strong, #164665); } .ds-link-row a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #24628a); outline-offset: 4px; } @media (max-width: 480px) { .ds-research { font-size: var(--body-size, calc(1rem + var(--font-size-adjust, 0px))); } }

components.css: @font-face { font-family: "Chinese YaHei"; src: local("Microsoft YaHei"), local("微软雅黑"), local("Microsoft YaHei UI"); font-display: swap; unicode-range: U+2E80-9FFF, U+F900-FAFF, U+FE10-FE1F, U+FE30-FE4F, U+FF00-FFEF, U+20000-2FA1F; } .ds-publication { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 8.25rem minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 1.2rem; color: var(--text, #3d4246); font-family: var(--font-text, "Chinese YaHei", -apple-system, ".SFNSText-Regular", "San Francisco", "Roboto", "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", "Lucida Grande", Arial, sans-serif); } .ds-pub-meta { padding-top: 0.3rem; } .ds-venue { display: block; color: var(--muted, #62686d); font-size: var(--body-size, calc(1.06rem + var(--font-size-adjust, 0px))); font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-publication h3 { margin: 0; color: var(--ink, #252a2e); font-size: max(calc(1.06rem + var(--font-size-adjust, 0px)), var(--body-size, calc(1.06rem + var(--font-size-adjust, 0px)))); font-weight: 650; line-height: 1.45; } .ds-publication p { margin: 0.45rem 0 0; color: var(--muted, #62686d); font-size: var(--body-size, calc(1.06rem + var(--font-size-adjust, 0px))); line-height: 1.65; } .ds-publication h3 + p { color: var(--text, #3d4246); } .ds-publication strong { color: var(--ink, #252a2e); font-weight: 700; } @media (max-width: 720px) { .ds-publication { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 0.45rem; } .ds-pub-meta { padding: 0; } } @media (max-width: 980px) { .ds-publication { --body-size: calc(1rem + var(--font-size-adjust, 0px)); } }

components.css: @font-face { font-family: "Chinese YaHei"; src: local("Microsoft YaHei"), local("微软雅黑"), local("Microsoft YaHei UI"); font-display: swap; unicode-range: U+2E80-9FFF, U+F900-FAFF, U+FE10-FE1F, U+FE30-FE4F, U+FF00-FFEF, U+20000-2FA1F; } .ds-software-link { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 0.8rem; justify-self: center; color: var(--accent, #24628a); font-family: var(--font-text, "Chinese YaHei", -apple-system, ".SFNSText-Regular", "San Francisco", "Roboto", "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", "Lucida Grande", Arial, sans-serif); font-size: calc(17px + var(--font-size-adjust, 0px)); line-height: 1.8; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-underline-offset: 0.18em; } .ds-software-link svg { display: block; width: 88px; height: 88px; } .ds-software-link:hover { color: var(--accent-strong, #164665); } .ds-software-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #24628a); outline-offset: 4px; } @media (max-width: 720px) { .ds-software-link { flex-direction: row; justify-self: start; gap: 1.2rem; } .ds-software-link svg { width: 64px; height: 64px; } } @media (max-width: 480px) { .ds-software-link { font-size: var(--body-size, calc(1rem + var(--font-size-adjust, 0px))); } }

narrative.overview: A plain academic homepage informed by Academic Pages, with its own composition. White space, system sans-serif Latin text, Song Chinese text, blue links, and gentle line and paragraph spacing support reading in both languages.
dos: Do keep every text element at least as large as the profile summary and preserve the English/Chinese line-height distinction.
Do keep records readable through spacing, plain headings, and conventional links.
Do preserve the original portrait, registration information, scholarly content, and bilingual links.
donts: Don't add research diagrams, a research subtitle, decorative monograms, marketing heroes, badges, or decorative animation.
Don't copy the Academic Pages template or turn this document into a new visual identity.
